name: scaffold-hbar-metered-mcp
description: Metered MCP server on Hedera: every tool call settles in HBAR on testnet and writes an HCS usage receipt.

instructions: Copy .env.example to .env and set METER_TREASURY_ACCOUNT to your Hedera testnet account.
Fund that account with testnet HBAR from the Hedera Portal faucet.
Install, then start the app and follow the setup flow: try the free ping, pay for a metered call, view receipts.

envVars.description: Testnet account that receives per-call HBAR payments, for example 0.0.123456.
Price per paid MCP tool call in tinybar. Default 10000.
Testnet HCS topic for usage receipts, for example 0.0.789012.
Testnet operator account id for submitting HCS receipts. Optional.
Testnet operator key for submitting HCS receipts. Optional, never commit.

steps: +Pay for your first tool call on Hedera testnet
Send the listed tinybar amount to the treasury, paste the payment transaction id, and verify the receipt on HashScan
